Name: Ani's Farmer Outfits
Author: GrannyAni
Description:
[center][size=6][b][FS] Ani's Farmer Outfits[/b][/size][/center]
[size=3]
[center]This mod adds a collection of cute farmer outfits such as overalls, suspenders and collared shirts. This pack uses fashion sense to add these new outfits. There are two main sets of this mod, set 1 contains pastel and desaturated shades whilst set 2 contains shades that better align with vanilla Stardew Valley (both sets can be used at the same time). The mod adds 6 unique outfits with 18 shades each (across the two sets), downloading both sets will add 108 new outfits into your game. Additionally, the color of all the undershirts can be changed using the in-game sliders to whatever color you may want![/center]

[size=5]Download information
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]If not already done, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] on your device[/size]
[*][size=3]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿﻿, since this is a pack for Fashion Sense[/size]
[*][size=3]Download the file from this mod page, and then unzip the files into your mods folder[/size]
[*][size=3]If these steps have been done correctly, run the game as normal and it should work! [/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Notes and other information
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]This mod can only be found on Nexus mods, if you find it uploaded anywhere [/size][size=3]else, please inform me and don't download this mod from any other [/size][size=3]websites.[/size]
[*][size=3]Both sets can be used at the same time, just put them into your mod folder as usual. Do not put one folder into the other.[/size]
[/list][/size][size=5]

[/size]
